prompt: I'm onboarding to this mail server and trying to understand how recipient address transformations are tracked. A colleague explained that when aliases rewrite addresses, the system maintains a "forward mapping" that stores what each original address was transformed into, so you can look up [user@domain.com](mailto:user@domain.com) and find it became [alias@domain.com](mailto:alias@domain.com). They said this mapping is built incrementally by each modifier as it runs, creating a chain of all intermediate transformations. They also mentioned something about using this for bounces. I checked the modify and dsn packages but couldn't find this mapping anywhere. Can you trace how address tracking actually works, find tests that verify it, run them, and show me the actual data structure and direction of the mapping? please clarify what the system actually does.
